description: Batched fast pinning (A), batched dirty unpinning (B), guarded 2 MiB host-memory mappings (D).
evidence_note: Each release's verification.evidence_patches lists the patch files with which its build_*, patched_diff_sha256, load and runtime fields were recorded. The current patch files differ from those only by license header lines, comments, compile-time #error guards that refuse a build in which NV_PIN_USER_PAGES would fall back to get_user_pages() (FOLL_GET), removal of the then-unused NV_NUM_PIN_PAGES_PER_ITERATION define, a defined(FOLL_NOFAULT) test next to the Linux >= 5.16 test, and, in 620.70.06, keeping upstream NV_UNPIN_USER_PAGES_DIRTY (unpin_user_pages_dirty_lock). patch_application was re-checked for the current files on 2026-11-12 (all apply to the exact source commit without offset or fuzz). verification.current_patch_build, where present, records a build of the current files; its os-mlock.o disassembly was compared with a build of the evidence_patches os-mlock.c using the same compiler command.

previous_patch_set.note: Load and runtime evidence for the earlier four-patch set (including the removed uvm_ext_map_debug patch). It does not cover the current patches.

runtime_validation.original_module_arguments: Replayed recorded original load arguments; all observable parameters and identities matched after restoration. Hidden parameters remain unobservable.
runtime_validation.validation_note: First validation controller omitted the CSV header and stopped after HtoD; original receipt retained. Correct header parsing verified HtoD, and the second roundtrip completed DtoH.

runtime_validation.evidence: measured on one RTX 3090 host; the data (internal results directory rtx3090-patchA-merged-20261111) is not included in this repository
runtime_validation.original_module_arguments: Each of the 11 loads was followed by cmt unpatch; srcversions, RegistryDwords (null) and the journal status "restored" were checked after every block. Hidden parameters remain unobservable.
runtime_validation.performance: measured on this machine only; interleaved with the unpatched modules
runtime_validation.pin_correctness: Same CUDA return codes and DMA data checks as the unpatched modules for mixed mapped/unmapped ranges, a range with a hole, re-registration after failure, read-only ranges, an untouched MAP_SHARED memfd, COW pages after fork and cudaHostAlloc; pinned pages balance with released pages.
